policy: Destination photography order: Pexels, then Unsplash, then Wikimedia Commons for region and country browse only when those have no suitable landscape, then the Seadays no-photo placeholder. Commons files must have a commercial-reuse licence (CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA, or public domain). Port destination heroes are not filled from Commons until an owner-approved country or region image is published. Ship heroes and terminal infrastructure photos are unchanged.

hamburg-germany.notes: Both Hamburg downloads are exterior harbour/Elbphilharmonie views. No interior photograph was present in the Downloads folder.
